conventions.height: base_link world-Z link-origin, actual minus commanded reference frame; control sample occurs 20ms after commanded frame time
conventions.velocity: world-Z base COM velocity reconstructed by quaternion rotation, compared with reference COM velocity
conventions.landing: 15ms sustained any-foot Fz >= 10N after first 15ms all-eight monitored Fz <10N; not all-body flight proof
conventions.episodes: complete cycles checked as all frames 0..169 with motion_finished only; truncated sixth cycle reported separately
conventions.runtime: PhysX joint stiffness/damping does not capture software actuator gain/delay draws
